about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/eval, the check-time evaluator (L7). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/eval; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it. Seeded by unit EV1 (wf10 l7-eval, 2026-11-10).

mutants.name: short-circuit-rhs
mutants.rule: && and || evaluate their right operand only when the left one does not decide (lower/expr.go binary).

mutants.name: int8-constant-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 value wraps at 8 bits: non-constant arithmetic wraps at its type's width (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: int8-op-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 operation wraps at 8 bits and gives an int8 (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: defect-caught
mutants.rule: A catch handles typed failures only; a defect is never caught (rows.md, Catch 6).

mutants.name: divide-by-zero-ok
mutants.rule: An integer division by zero is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: negative-shift-ok
mutants.rule: A shift by a negative count is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: variant-test-true
mutants.rule: A type pattern matches a union value only of that variant (rows.md, Totality; a Go type switch).

mutants.name: returned-error-is-value
mutants.rule: Returning a value of an error type is a failure (types.md, Error types 2).

mutants.name: absent-fact-pure
mutants.rule: An absent footprint is not an empty one (rows.md, Footprints 2): an internal error, never a pure frame.

mutants.name: defect-continues
mutants.rule: A defect stops the run (runtime.md, Tests 3).

mutants.name: incomplete-continues
mutants.rule: The budget is per request: once it runs out, every later obligation is reported not run (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: fuel-ignored
mutants.rule: Every evaluated node costs steps before its work, so a loop that never ends exhausts the budget (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: skip-as-pass
mutants.from: res.Status, res.Reason = Skipped, "a law takes generated cases
mutants.to: res.Status, res.Reason = Passed, "a law takes generated cases
mutants.rule: A skipped law is never a pass (runtime.md, Tests 7; L7 plan, section 5).
